fichas.title: Thermal insulation
fichas.summary: Explains thermal insulation, heat transfer, thermal conductivity, thermal resistance, surface resistance, overall resistance, and thermal transmittance. Illustrations show temperature curves for single-layer and multi-layer building elements and calculations for an insulated external wall and a pitched roof. The pitched roof example distinguishes insulated-area and rafter proportions and lists upper and lower limit values.
uses: Calculate thermal transmittance (U-value) for walls and roofs
